summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly disclosures: declared regular and supplemental distributions per share class, provided NAV per share as of July 31, 2026, and updated its continuous public offering status. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. It is an ordinary current report of operational and financial data. The registrant acts solely as filer disclosing standard fund metrics and offering progress. No action required.
